Known as Egypt’s “Venice of the Red Sea,”

is not only a haven for water sports and relaxation—it also offers easy access to temples and archaeological excursions across the Eastern Desert and Nile Valley. Whether you’re seeking serene lagoon views, pampering spa experiences, or culturally rich boutique stays, the
offer a wide range of premium accommodations tailored to every kind of traveller.
La Maison Bleue – Timeless Elegance in a Private Lagoon
Approximately 4 km from APl Gouna town centre
Elegant suites with mountain, sea, or pool views
Free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, tea and coffee makers
Complimentary breakfast and exclusive fine-dining restaurant
Private beach and tranquil lagoon-side setting
The atmosphere here is distinctly romantic and aristocratic—ideal for honeymooners and design enthusiasts seeking privacy and flair.
Ancient Sands Golf Resort – Nubian Charm Meets Modern Comfort
Nubian-inspired architecture with sweeping Red Sea views
Spacious suites featuring kitchens and comfortable living areas
Multiple pools, golf facilities, and wellness centre
Great for longer stays or family holidays. Ask about their apartment-style suites with fully equipped kitchens for home-style convenience.
Sheraton Miramar Resort – Island Luxury on the Waterfront
Approximately 4 km from Steigenberger Golf Resort
Deluxe rooms with terraces overlooking lagoons and private beaches
Free Wi-Fi, 24-hour room service, multiple dining options
Outdoor pools, on-site spa, and family-friendly entertainment
This resort’s Arabic architecture and lush gardens are especially scenic at sunset—ideal for photography lovers and sunset seekers.
Steigenberger Golf Resort – Al Gouna’s Iconic Green Retreat
Central Al Gouna, set around an 18-hole championship course
Rooms with garden terraces and golf course views
Indoor and outdoor pools, spa, gym, and kids’ facilities
Perfect for travellers who want to combine wellness with activity. The resort is quiet, clean, and close to the town’s marina and attractions.
